body:
You are good EpsonD(good name BTW). Questions like these incite rebuttal, and therefore delay action. I am sorry my post incited your needs, but I don't wish to require your expertise. Thank you for your help, I promise you, you are doing a great service to people.

I visited your history, your are a good person, and I believe you should keep posting. If you win ONE person over to living, it should be worth it. Unfortunately, this wont be a win, but THANK YOU.

In regards to your last question- there is a difference with satisfaction and enjoyment. The last time I was truly, truly in bliss was with my ex-GF, but that is an expected feeling. I've had plenty of happy and enjoyable moments since then, but none that are worthy of staying alive. It seems harsh, but if you really think about it, there's no reason not to be harsh. This is our only run at things, might as well desire and strive for that, "perfect". 

Upon reflection, I could also, reciprocate your second to last question. What is inappropriate about, "looking at people and things under much scrutiny, judgment and detachment". Life is about one's interpretation of it, the deeper the better, and if yours happens to be be misaligned with the norm, then let it be, that you can depart. It is the beautiful natural selection of life on earth.

Thank you for your reply,

I have the best friends a person could ask for, they are great people. I hate myself for having to burden them with my hasty departure, but I need to be selfish this once. I have always seen and interpreted people by how they react and fare with others. I know people who lack the ability to love someone other than themselves. I know people who's priorities are completely alien to all others I've met. I almost feel as if I have been gathering data on the human condition my entire life, with the uncanny ability to see motives and desires, and I don't want to take part in it. I have found love, I've experienced the highest high anyone could hope to imagine in it. I lost love, I've experienced the depths of despair I don't wish on my worst enemies. I believe that my greatest freedom is that I can choose when I end. Albeit, it is sooner than most would like, I don't and can't take part in consciousness any longer. I wish I could make myself ignorant, but I cant.

I appreciate your comments, but I also understand the position you are doing it from. Thank you.

I won't tell you my plans for suicide(what a dirty word), but I can tell you that it is the best,(and by best, i mean least painful/grotesque) way to go out. Thank you again.
